name: Valle del Miño-Ourense

known.via: English Wikipedia "Valle del Miño-Ourense" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Galician Vino de la Tierra indication in Ourense province.
